description: The Apr23 Giant Ibis group is described as more than a dozen laid-off employees over two days; the 80 laid-off workers are a cohort, not event attendance. The demand chiefly targeted the employer, with a letter to the Labor Ministry, so neither the ≥50 simultaneous threshold nor state-directed demand is established.
required_followup: Only revise if a contemporaneous source documents a ≥50 simultaneous public gathering or a clear demand to state policy/officials. Preserve day-two date as unknown and do not transfer the 80-person layoff cohort into attendance.
